en: Done beats perfect. Ship one small thing today.
Talk to one real customer before you build anything new.
Consistency compounds. Show up for 30 minutes, even on a bad day.
Your first sale matters more than your logo.

Track your numbers. What gets measured gets better.
Small steps, every day. That is the whole secret.
You don't need more ideas. You need one finished task.

Every expert started with clumsy first attempts.
Protect your 30 minutes today like a meeting you can't miss.
Progress, not perfection. Publish, learn, improve.

One uncomfortable message could bring your first client.
Boring consistency beats brilliant bursts.
Finish before you polish.
Rejection is data, not a verdict.

You chose this. Now make it work, one step at a time.
